pkgmetadata.longdescription: tcmu-runner handles the userspace side of the Linux kernel LIO SCSI target's TCM-User (TCMU) backstore. It lets a userspace process back a LIO-exported LUN, and ships handlers for Ceph RBD, GlusterFS, qcow2, zbc and plain files. It is required by sys-cluster/ceph-iscsi to export Ceph RBD images as iSCSI LUNs.

use.flag: Build the glfs handler, exporting GlusterFS volumes as TCMU-backed LUNs (pulls in sys-cluster/glusterfs)
Build the rbd handler, exporting Ceph RBD images as TCMU-backed LUNs (pulls in sys-cluster/ceph)
Link against dev-util/google-perftools' tcmalloc allocator instead of the system malloc()
